title: The pushforward and the global sections of the pullback of a module under the structure morphism in the vanishing situation

difficulty_reason: The lemma computes both the pushforward and the global sections of the pullback of an $A$-module along the structure morphism in the vanishing situation (statement lines 3008-3013). The proof first notes that the pushforward statement follows from the global sections statement because the pushforward is quasi-coherent on the affine base, then handles free modules through the known computation of global sections of direct sums, and finally presents a general module by free modules and uses the vanishing of $H^1$ together with right exactness of the pullback. The reduction to free modules through a presentation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
